meta.name: postgres-pro
meta.description: Use when optimizing PostgreSQL queries, configuring replication, or implementing advanced database features. Invoke for EXPLAIN analysis, JSONB operations, extension usage, VACUUM tuning, performance monitoring.

copy.tagline: 优化 PostgreSQL 查询与数据库性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要分析和优化 PostgreSQL 数据库性能
copy.tagline_en: Optimize PostgreSQL queries and database performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently analyze and optimize PostgreSQL database performance

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 PostgreSQL 专家：用 EXPLAIN 分析慢查询、设计索引、优化 SQL、配置流复制或逻辑复制，并监控 VACUUM 和复制延迟，产出带前后验证的 SQL 方案。
howto.when: 当你要求用 EXPLAIN 分析慢查询、配置复制（流/逻辑）、处理 JSONB、调 VACUUM 或查看 pg_stat 等时触发；提到 PostgreSQL、EXPLAIN ANALYZE、pg_stat 等也会进入。

say.text: 用 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 分析这条慢查询，指出瓶颈并给出索引方案
say.note: 会输出执行计划解读和索引建议

say.text: 帮我设置两台 PostgreSQL 之间的流复制，并给出延迟监控查询
这个 JSONB 字段查询很慢，建什么索引？
say.note: 会建议 GIN 索引并验证使用情况

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a PostgreSQL expert: analyzes slow queries with EXPLAIN, designs indexes, rewrites SQL, sets up streaming or logical replication, and monitors VACUUM and replication lag. Outputs SQL with before/after verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask for EXPLAIN analysis, replication setup, JSONB indexing, VACUUM tuning, or pg_stat monitoring, or mention PostgreSQL, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, pg_stat, etc.

say_en.text: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE on this slow query, point out bottlenecks and suggest an index
say_en.note: Provides plan interpretation and index suggestions

say_en.text: Set up streaming replication between two PostgreSQL servers and give a lag monitoring query
say_en.note: Provides config steps and pg_stat_replication monitoring

say_en.text: This JSONB query is slow; what index should I create?
say_en.note: Suggests a GIN index and verifies usage
